Class Blackboard

java.lang.Object
renderer.sampling.Blackboard
public class Blackboard extends Object
Generates 2D sampling points on a target area. This class is used as a generic multi-sampling engine.

      public Blackboard setSize(double size)
      Set the size of the sampling area. Both width and height are set to the same value.
      Parameters:
      size - the size of the sampling area (width and height). Must be non-negative.
      Returns:
      this Blackboard instance for method chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if size is negative

    • setSize

      public Blackboard setSize(double width, double height)
      Set the size of the sampling area with specified width and height.
      Parameters:
      width - the width of the sampling area. Must be non-negative.
      height - the height of the sampling area. Must be non-negative.
      Returns:
      this Blackboard instance for method chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if width or height is negative

    • setGridSize

      public Blackboard setGridSize(int gridSize)
      Set the grid size for sampling. The grid size determines how many samples are generated along each axis. Must be at least 1.
      Parameters:
      gridSize - the number of samples along each axis. Must be at least 1.
      Returns:
      this Blackboard instance for method chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if gridSize is less than 1

    • generatePoints

      public List<Point> generatePoints(Point center, Vector axisX, Vector axisY)
      Convert the generated 2D sample offsets into world points. Each sample (x,y) is transformed to center + axisX * x + axisY * y.
      Parameters:
      center - the center point of the sampling area
      axisX - the direction corresponding to the sample x axis
      axisY - the direction corresponding to the sample y axis
      Returns:
      list of transformed points in world coordinates
